For our furry friend (a Maine Coon who doesn't really like being groomed) we couldn't have found a better place... Professionalism, kindness... a guarantee!

I met Dog in the City years ago when no one wanted to groom Peky, my twenty-year-old cat, without anesthesia.... Debora, on the other hand, managed not only to groom him but to maintain his splendid coat even at an advanced age..... Then I went from one cat to another and even Sky, my Ragdoll, willingly comes to be groomed during the shedding season, Debora also taught me how to use the slicker and the carder to keep him at his best even at home. Then three years ago Ellie the Pomeranian arrived and Vanessa keeps her coat beautiful every month....by now they know my animals and my animals know them, they are always very calm both when I bring them and when I pick them up. Debora and Vanessa are very punctual, very good and competent and with a rare empathy. They also pay great attention to the health of their ears, teeth and nails and always have the right advice for the situation. I think my Pomeranian now considers Vanessa part of the family 💖 and I take her back from the groomer always more beautiful than before.
I've recommended Dog in the City to my friends (they've all been happy) and I'd recommend it to anyone.
I've purchased some of their products (colloidal silver for ear cleaning, brushes, combs, and products for washing my Pomeranian at home, too), and I've always been very satisfied and highly recommended. THANK YOU to Debora and Vanessa 💕

Debora has been caring for my furry friends for years, and today she has Vanessa by her side. They're welcoming, professional, attentive, and show a firm sense of gentleness and care for our furry friends. I wouldn't change them for anything in the world.

Professional and reliable! She cared for my cocker spaniel until he was 17 with dedication and patience. Now she takes care of the beauty of my two puppies. I could never trust anyone else.
Professionalism, empathy, and meticulous attention to each dog are the hallmarks of this place. Debora and Vanessa are exceptional, even with the most stubborn dogs.
good and very attentive

The staff are unfriendly, their manners are blunt, and they lack courtesy. To make matters worse, they demand cash payments... If you're looking for courtesy and transparency for your dog, look elsewhere.

A truly negative experience. They clipped my five-pound mixed breed terribly. I only asked for his body to be very short and uniform, and it was a very simple cut, and they gave him a patchy clip. A little long, a little short, with no uniformity whatsoever. They also shaved half of his tail, making it look like a plume. They didn't even touch his muzzle. Needless to say, he was washed thoroughly afterwards...

I can't be satisfied with my dog's haircut, aside from the fact that the clipper said he had diarrhea, which I'm sorry about. He was fine and hadn't had it before I brought him to the shop, otherwise I would have sent him back. His fur can't be left so poorly cut, uneven with noticeable longer tufts along his body and legs, with his head so long in relation to his body, practically untrimmed (we asked for the hair to be trimmed). His tail is also shaved all the way down to the base, almost halfway down, when we only asked for it to be trimmed. Furthermore, as you can see from the photos, he has several small dirt spots on the side and around his bottom; he could have been washed and clipped much better. I'm sorry, but I don't recommend this as a haircut.
Thank you so much for giving us 5 stars. See you soon!
My dog ​​hates water; well, the skill of these two wonderful ladies has made Lady love grooming. They're incredibly talented and professional, as well as incredibly empathetic. Highly recommended.

Disastrous experience. Rudeness from the owners, never again!

This person injured my cat's paws by cutting her nails, causing them to bleed to the pulp, and I had to tell her to stop!! Then I ran to the vet to repair the damage to the poor animal: I kept the reports and photos and she won't get away with it by thinking that since the shop was closed due to Covid (which started shortly thereafter) everyone will forget, because OIPA, which I called, has copies of everything and now there are no more restrictions to prevent her from harming other animals again. Being an aggressive incompetent who, I don't know in what capacity and with what conscience, still keeps such a place open where they still advertise as if nothing had happened. After the vet's timely intervention, I had to disinfect and put socks on my cat for 20 days, and I thank heavens that she didn't suffer necrosis on the severed paws: such an unfortunate person deserves a criminal complaint and must be prevented from handling any living being again.
I'll add: given the response of this "lady" who dares to say that my cat is aggressive, the poor animal she mistreated like a fool and made her bleed, I warn her not to downplay such a serious matter, of which I have photos and medical records, much less threaten me. When someone can't perform a simple operation, she stops, and if she's afraid of a cat, she should change jobs: something she should have done already! I'm not even the only one reporting negative reviews about her, who has the audacity to accuse a little animal instead of offering an apology, and this defines her. Don't try again, or I'll report her for animal cruelty, is that clear?
I received this woman's apology, and I hope it's heartfelt.
Even if reviews are removed by fascist censors, it doesn't change anything: anyone who makes an animal bleed because they're incompetent must close down, and if I receive any more threats from this person, in addition to OIPA I'll also call the Carabinieri: apologies have never been enough for me.
